name: Shed Turnstile
author: teamstaccato

sections.description:
Shed Turnstile provides centralized management of Cloudflare Turnstile Site Key and Secret Key, offering a shared API for compatible plugins such as Shed Form.

Features:

  • Centralized Site Key / Secret Key management
  • API functions callable from other plugins
  • Turnstile widget rendering helper
  • Server-side token verification

API Functions

  • shedturn_is_configured() — Check if keys are configured
  • shedturn_render_widget( $args ) — Return widget HTML
  • shedturn_verify_token( $token, $ip ) — Verify a Turnstile token
  • shedturn_enqueue_script() — Enqueue Cloudflare JS

日本語の説明

Shed Turnstile は Cloudflare Turnstile の Site Key / Secret Key を一元管理し、Shed Form などの対応プラグインに共通の API を提供します。

主な機能:

  • Site Key / Secret Key の一元管理
  • 他プラグインから呼び出せる API 関数
  • Turnstile ウィジェットの描画ヘルパー
  • トークンのサーバーサイド検証

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to Cloudflare’s servers for Turnstile verification.

  • Service: Cloudflare Turnstile
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/
  • Terms of Service: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/
  • Data sent: Turnstile token, site key, user IP address
  • When: Each time a form with Turnstile enabled is submitted
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Go to Settings → Shed Turnstile and enter your Cloudflare Turnstile Site Key and Secret Key.
  4. Compatible plugins (e.g. Shed Form) will automatically detect and use the configured keys.
sections.faq:
Where do I get a Turnstile Site Key and Secret Key?

Log in to your Cloudflare dashboard, navigate to Turnstile, and create a new site. The Site Key and Secret Key will be provided.

Does this plugin work standalone?

This plugin manages Turnstile keys and provides an API. To use Turnstile on your forms, you need a compatible form plugin such as Shed Form.

Is Cloudflare Turnstile free?

Yes. Cloudflare Turnstile is a free CAPTCHA alternative service.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • Added: shedturn_render_widget() accepts an optional “action” argument (letters, digits, underscore and hyphen, up to 32 characters). It is printed as data-action on the widget, so a plugin can tell its forms apart by passing the same value to shedturn_verify_token() as $args[‘action’]. Existing callers are not affected.

1.3.0

  • Security: The verification now checks the host name in Cloudflare’s answer. It must be this site’s host (the home URL or the site URL, with or without “www.”); the Host header of the request is not used, because an attacker can set it. An answer without a host name fails. The filter shedturn_allowed_hostnames adds more hosts (several domains, or Cloudflare’s test keys). The calling plugin can also pass an expected action (shedturn_verify_token( $token, $ip, array( ‘action’ => ‘…’ ) )).
  • Security: The Site Key and the Secret Key can be set in wp-config.php with the constants SHEDTURN_SITE_KEY and SHEDTURN_SECRET_KEY, or with the filters shedturn_site_key and shedturn_secret_key. The settings screen then shows “set by a constant” and never shows the value, and nothing is saved in the database.
  • Security: The verification request uses wp_safe_remote_post with an 8 second timeout. If the request fails, the verification fails.
  • Added: The log tells apart a reused or expired token (reason token_reused), a host name that does not match (hostname_mismatch) and an action that does not match (action_mismatch).

1.2.0

  • Added: The settings screen now shows a “Verification status” table with daily counts (today and the last 7 days) of passed, failed, token-missing, connection-error and missing-secret-key verifications. Counts only; no personal data is stored. Only 14 days are kept, and the data is removed when the plugin is uninstalled.
  • Added: A form that submits without a Turnstile token (a bot posting directly, or a script that never ran the widget) is now counted, and recorded in the debug log when debug mode is on. Previously such submissions were rejected without any trace.

1.1.2

  • Security: Client IP detection no longer trusts the X-Forwarded-For header unconditionally. The header is now only used when the request demonstrably passes through a proxy (REMOTE_ADDR is a private/reserved address), and the right-most value is taken instead of the left-most one. On directly exposed servers the header is ignored entirely, which prevents visitors from spoofing their IP address.
  • Added: Sites behind an external CDN (Cloudflare and similar) are detected on the settings screen, with instructions for defining SHEDTURN_TRUSTED_PROXY_HEADER in wp-config.php.
  • Tweak: remoteip is no longer sent to the Cloudflare siteverify endpoint when the client IP cannot be determined.
  • Tweak: Declared compatibility with WordPress 7.1.

1.1.1

  • Added: CSV download button for debug log.
  • Added: One-click connection test on the settings page.

1.1.0

  • Added: Debug log feature — record Turnstile verification results in the admin dashboard (Settings > Shed Turnstile > Debug Log tab).

1.0.7

  • Confirmed compatibility with WordPress 7.0

1.0.6

  • Fixed: Apply wp_unslash() to nonce field in admin settings save handler
  • Added: languages/shed-turnstile.pot for translation support

1.0.5

  • Fixed: Sanitize externally-supplied $ip parameter in shedturn_verify_token()
  • Fixed: Remove HTTP_CLIENT_IP trust in shedturn_get_client_ip() (spoofable header)
  • Fixed: Add is_array() guard on json_decode result
  • Added: Screenshots section to readme.txt

1.0.4

  • Added: GPL-2.0 LICENSE file
  • Added: Domain Path header
  • Fixed: i18n — all user-facing strings wrapped with __()
  • Fixed: uninstall.php now removes legacy wsf_turnstile_* options

1.0.3

  • Changed: All function, class, constant, hook, and option prefixes renamed from wst_/WST_ to shedturn_/SHEDTURN_/Shedturn_.

1.0.2

  • Changed: Plugin slug

upgrade_notice.1.4.0: New optional "action" argument for the widget. Nothing changes for existing forms.
upgrade_notice.1.3.0: Verification is stricter: the host name in Cloudflare's answer must be this site's host (add more with the shedturn_allowed_hostnames filter if you use several domains). You can now keep the keys out of the database with SHEDTURN_SITE_KEY and SHEDTURN_SECRET_KEY in wp-config.php.
upgrade_notice.1.2.0: Adds a verification status table to the settings screen so you can see how many submissions pass, fail or arrive without a token. No action required.
upgrade_notice.1.1.2: Security fix: the X-Forwarded-For header is no longer trusted unconditionally when determining the client IP. Sites behind an external CDN (Cloudflare and similar) should define SHEDTURN_TRUSTED_PROXY_HEADER in wp-config.php — the settings screen shows instructions when this applies.
upgrade_notice.1.0.6: Apply wp_unslash() to nonce field before verification for WordPress Coding Standards compliance.
upgrade_notice.1.0.5: Security hardening: sanitize externally-supplied IP address in verify_token(). Remove HTTP_CLIENT_IP trust.
upgrade_notice.1.0.4: Added i18n support and GPL-2.0 LICENSE file for WordPress.org compliance.
upgrade_notice.1.0.3: All prefixes renamed. If upgrading from 1.0.2 or earlier, existing Turnstile keys will be automatically migrated.
